scope: Self-authored EL0 Q0..Q31, FPCR/FPSR, TLS, MMU/ASID, QARMA5 and real timer preemption; historical single-vCPU samples and new two-vCPU migration samples are separately scoped.
limitations: The historical 2026-10-16 samples use one vCPU; newer two-vCPU scope is separate below.
Selected FPCR and FPSR values, no broad FP arithmetic exception test
No SVE, SME, FPMR, asynchronous nested IRQ or OS scheduler
Three VMApple profiles share QEMU code and are not separate hardware implementations
No Apple PAC cryptography equivalent, Apple firmware, TSS, iBEC, Stage2 or macOS
Counts are functional events, not native-performance or sustained reliability measurements
guest_code_sha256_scope: Historical 2026-10-16 single-vCPU sources; current per-run firmware hashes are in the referenced runtime reports.

cross_vcpu_migration.negative_scope: TLS, Q30/Q31 and key use the six corresponding cases in negative_controls; wrong-asid uses the two final stricter TTBR classifications in ttbr_negative_final. Original reports remain intact; these are separate invocations, not one full run.
cross_vcpu_migration.wrong_asid_scope: Restores the other task TTBR0 including both table base and ASID; not an isolated ASID-tag mutation.
cross_vcpu_migration.cpu_identity_scope: TPIDRRO_EL0 is initialized on each CPU and checked against MPIDR_EL1 at exception entry; EL0 records the local CPU after state checks and actual PAC return.
cross_vcpu_migration.context_handoff: Both CPUs save full context, release task ownership and publish an epoch before acquiring the peer epoch and atomically claiming the other task.
cross_vcpu_migration.shared_state: Distinct ASIDs, physical data and stacks; all Q0..Q31, FPCR/FPSR, TLS, integer frame, SP, TTBR0 and architectural PAuth keys migrate.
cross_vcpu_migration.single_vcpu_regression_scope: Two separate positive 12-round samples: clock-exact and reims-model. The latter verifies the model initialization refactor at its original 1GHz setting; historical 44+4 samples were not rerun.
limits: Two self-authored tasks and two vCPUs, not an OS scheduler or XNU.
Both scheduling modes use one QEMU binary, not independent hardware.
No SVE/SME/FPMR, nested IRQ, DMA/IOMMU, sustained reliability or performance claim.
Does not resolve the M2 platform callback or prove Apple cryptographic equivalence.

software_key_model.task_state: Per-task explicit diversifier; EL1 kernel key values are not stored as user-task state.

lazy_fp.negative_scope: Only the injected missing-restore path disables its local timer so the real EL0 data comparison reports before the next EL1 owner check; host timeouts never pass.
